facts: Parties: Elstree Technologies Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Analytics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Pemberton Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 6 March 2027; Closing is scheduled for 7 May 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,100,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,800,000.
